ar.title: كفتة اللحم بالخبز البلدي

steps.n1: ينقع الرغيف البلدي في ماء قليل حتى يلين ثم يعصر جيدا من الماء.
steps.n2: يخلط باللحم المفروم جيدا ثم يتبل بالملح والفلفل.
steps.n3: تبشر البصلة وتعصر من مائها جيدا ويؤخذ البشر فقط دون الماء، وتخلط جيدا باللحم، ثم يضاف البيض حسب سمك العجينة مع الثوم المفري والبقدونس ويعجنوا جيدا.
steps.n4: تكوَر صغيرا ثم تبطط على هيئة دوائر.
steps.n5: توضع الدوائر أولا في البقسماط خفيفا جدا، ثم بالفرشة يدهن الوجهان بالبيض.

en.title: Meat Kofta with Traditional Bread

steps.n1: Soak the Baladi bread in a little water until soft, then squeeze it thoroughly to remove all excess water.
steps.n2: Mix the bread well with the ground beef, then season with salt and pepper.
steps.n3: Grate the onion and squeeze it thoroughly to remove the liquid, using only the grated pulp; mix it well into the meat, then add the eggs (depending on the consistency of the mixture) along with the minced garlic and parsley, and knead well.
steps.n4: Form into small balls, then flatten them into discs.
steps.n5: Lightly coat the discs in breadcrumbs first, then use a brush to coat both sides with egg.
steps.n6: Fry in oil until golden brown.

legacySteps: Soak the Baladi bread in a little water until soft, then squeeze it thoroughly to remove all excess water.

Grate the onion and squeeze it thoroughly to remove the liquid, using only the grated pulp; mix it well into the meat, then add the eggs (depending on the consistency of the mixture) along with the minced garlic and parsley, and knead well.
Form into small balls, then flatten them into discs.
Lightly coat the discs in breadcrumbs first, then use a brush to coat both sides with egg.
Fry in oil until golden brown.
